info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Airline Flights Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Status API provides real-time information about the status of flights for various airlines. Users can retrieve updates on departing and arriving flights, including delays and cancellations. This API is essential for travel companies, booking platforms, and passengers who need the latest flight information to make informed travel decisions. Consumers can leverage this service to enhance user experience by integrating accurate flight status data into their applications.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a flight.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to check the current status of a specific flight, providing information such as departure and arrival times, delays, and gate information.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the status of flights. It should contain the parameters needed to query the current status information of flights, formatted as a JSON object.

200.description: The flight status was retrieved successfully.
